description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Ice)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Ultima Arrow (0~2), removed after using Apex Ultima Arrow two times

description.name: Apex Ultima Arrow Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Ultima Arrow level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Ice)]

description.name: Apex Ultima Arrow Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Ultima Arrow level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Ice)]
